## Pull request overview

Adds a dual-transport architecture to `@objectstack/driver-turso` so the driver can operate in **remote-only** mode (pure `@libsql/client`) in addition to existing local/replica modes (SqlDriver/Knex + better-sqlite3).

**Changes:**
- Introduces `RemoteTransport` implementing CRUD/bulk/transactions/schema over `@libsql/client`.
- Adds `transportMode` auto-detection (`local | replica | remote`) with optional `config.mode` override and `config.client` injection.
- Updates docs/roadmap/changelog and expands test coverage for mode detection + remote mode integration.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts | Adds mode detection, remote delegation, and new public properties (`transportMode`, `isRemote`). |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts | New remote-only transport implementing SQL compilation + execution via `@libsql/client`. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.test.ts | Adds mode detection tests and remote-mode CRUD integration tests (in-memory libsql client). |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/index.ts | Exposes new exports (`TursoTransportMode`, `RemoteTransport`). |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/README.md | Documents remote mode, auto-detection, and client injection. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks dual transport phase as complete. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the dual transport addition and remote-only support. |
</details>

RemoteTransport’s CRUD/execute methods don’t accept `options` and always run against `this.client`, so there’s no way to execute queries within a transaction via `options.transaction` as required by IDataDriver (beginTransaction() explicitly returns a handle to pass through options). Consider updating these methods to accept `options?: DriverOptions` and execute against `options.transaction ?? this.client` to make remote transactions functional.

`buildSelectSQL()` interpolates table names, selected fields, and ORDER BY direction directly into SQL strings. Since QueryAST field names are only validated as `string` (no identifier regex) this opens a SQL injection path if untrusted input reaches the driver. Add strict identifier validation/escaping for `object` and all column names, and whitelist order direction to `ASC`/`DESC` before embedding it into SQL.

The file-level docstring says RemoteTransport is “not exposed directly to users”, but `src/index.ts` exports it as part of the public package API. Either stop exporting it (keep it internal) or update the RemoteTransport/TursoDriver docs to explicitly treat it as a supported public API (including stability/semver guarantees).
